reviews.title: Worked great!
reviews.comment: Works good! My daughter wanted this to record music and it worked good and she was able to do it herself. Easy to hook up. Simple to use
reviews.author: Kara Kupsh

reviews.title: Does As Advertised
reviews.comment: Easy to use, easy instructions, works like a charm. Does exactly as advertised, no more, no less. I'm finally able to add music onto my computer. I like that the cable has a holder on the bottom so it doesn't flap around useless or messy when you want to store it back in its box. It is a little lightweight, so handle with care.
reviews.author: Kai Jandrok

reviews.title: Was it worth it?
reviews.comment: Nice and compact, easy to use, and in todays world... will not get much use, but did it's job and was well worth it!
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.title: Buy this one
reviews.comment: I wish I would have just bought this one first! Looks great, just plug and play, worked faster than I thought it would and actually worked with my Mac! 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Wyatt Helean

reviews.title: Good product
reviews.comment: It works and the price was very reasonable.
